exposure: Ovarian morphometry (shape, color, length, width, thickness)
cohort: 31 women of reproductive age who underwent surgical or autopsy procedures
finding: Macroscopic and clinical factors, such as age and caesarean section history, may be significantly associated with ovarian reserve as estimated by ovarian histology.
mod_finding: Women with a caesarean-section history yielded significantly lower primordial/primary follicular counts.
